composition_variation: Create an original anime summer portrait of a visibly adult 25-year-old woman pausing on a quiet wooden boardwalk with a pistachio gelato. Give her clear hazel eyes, a gentle heart-shaped adult face, elegant straight brows, naturally colored lips, and a bright confident smile. Her muted coral-pink hair forms a loose side braid secured with a tiny ivory ribbon. She wears an opaque apricot cotton midi dress with short puff sleeves, a modest crew neckline, practical side pockets, and simple white canvas shoes. One hand holds the gelato upright at chest level without eating it; the other rests casually inside the dress pocket. Her torso turns a little toward the sea while her gaze returns warmly toward the viewer. The composition includes weathered pale planks, a distant striped beach kiosk without lettering, and a broad ribbon of clear blue water. A few tiny gull silhouettes may appear low on the horizon. Use fresh apricot, pistachio, coral, and blue accents in clean cel shading enriched by fine watercolor-like edges. Keep the pose easy, fully balanced, and convincingly everyday. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
